description: Structured eval definitions for the AWS Control Tower Account Factory Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Account Factory scenarios (standard account vending with SSO and Guardrails, custom baseline via CloudFormation StackSets, group-based SSO auto-assignment with provisioning, account termination lifecycle, unregistered OU prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Standard account vending via Account Factory with SSO and Guardrails
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Service Catalog provisioning, registered OU, Guardrail inheritance, SSO permission set, baseline StackSets
eval_cases.prompt: Vend a new AWS account "data-platform-prod" via Control Tower Account Factory in us-east-1. Root email aws+prod-data-platform@company.com. Target OU "Custom (DataPlatform)" (ou-bbb-ccc). SSO admin email platform-lead@company.com. Assign DataEngineerAccess permission set to group DataPlatformTeam. Management account 123456789012. Identity Center instance ssoins-12345. Tags: Environment=production, OU=DataPlatform.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACCOUNT_FACTORY: data-platform-prod (123456789012) in OU DataPlatform (ou-bbb-ccc)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Account email: aws+prod-data-platform@company.com — UNIQUE
  [✓] Target OU: Custom (DataPlatform) (ou-bbb-ccc) — REGISTERED
  [✓] Guardrails (SCP): preventive controls inherited from OU
  [✓] Baseline StackSets: AWSControlTowerLogging — DEPLOYED, AWSControlTowerSecurity — DEPLOYED
  [✓] Permission sets: DataEngineerAccess assigned to DataPlatformTeam
  [✓] SSO provisioning: SUCCEEDED
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws organizations describe-account --account-id 123456789012
  aws organizations list-policies-for-target --target-id 123456789012 --filter SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY

eval_cases.name: Account vending with custom baseline via CloudFormation StackSets
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — custom StackSet deployed alongside default Control Tower baseline, VPC customization verified
eval_cases.prompt: Vend a new account "ml-platform-prod" via Account Factory with a custom baseline. Root email aws+prod-ml@company.com. OU "Custom (ML)" (ou-ml-001). Custom StackSet "CustomBaseline-VPC" deploying a VPC with public/private subnets. Default Control Tower baseline expected. Assign MLResearcherAccess to MLTeam group. Management account 123456789012. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACCOUNT_FACTORY: ml-platform-prod (<account-id>) in OU ML (ou-ml-001)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Custom baseline: CustomBaseline-VPC — DEPLOYED
  [✓] Baseline StackSets: all DEPLOYED
  [✓] Permission sets: MLResearcherAccess assigned to MLTeam

eval_cases.name: Group-based SSO auto-assignment with permission set provisioning
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SSO group assignment, permission set provisioned to account, three-way binding verified
eval_cases.prompt: Vend a new account "security-audit" via Account Factory in OU "Custom (Security)" (ou-sec-001). Root email aws+security-audit@company.com. Assign SecurityAuditorAccess permission set to SecurityTeam group for this account. SSO instance ssoins-12345. Management account 123456789012. Tags: Environment=production, Team=Security.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACCOUNT_FACTORY: security-audit (<account-id>) in OU Security (ou-sec-001)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Permission sets: SecurityAuditorAccess assigned to SecurityTeam
  [✓] SSO provisioning: SecurityAuditorAccess provisioned — SUCCEEDED
  [✓] Three-way binding: SecurityTeam + SecurityAuditorAccess + account

eval_cases.name: Account Factory account termination with lifecycle handling
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — terminate provisioned product, SSO removal, 90-day SUSPENDED period noted
eval_cases.prompt: Terminate the account "sandbox-dev-001" (account-id 111122223333) that was vended via Account Factory. The account is in OU "Custom (Sandbox)" (ou-sbx-001). Management account 123456789012. Remove SSO assignments, dis-enroll from Control Tower, and note the 90-day SUSPENDED period.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACCOUNT_FACTORY: sandbox-dev-001 (111122223333)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] SSO assignments: removed
  [✓] Control Tower enrollment: dis-enrolled
  [✓] Lifecycle: SUSPENDED (90 days to permanent closure)

eval_cases.name: Account vending into unregistered OU (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — OU 'LegacyApps' (ou-leg-999) is not registered with Control Tower; no Guardrails or baselines
eval_cases.prompt: Vend a new account "legacy-app" via Account Factory into OU "LegacyApps" (ou-leg-999) which is NOT registered with Control Tower. Root email aws+legacy-app@company.com. Management account 123456789012. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ACCOUNT_FACTORY: legacy-app
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Target OU: LegacyApps (ou-leg-999) — NOT REGISTERED with Control Tower
